name: Regulatory interpretation

subjectOf.text: Enforcing AI regulation in a federated model is complex because different entities may interpret the same regulations differently and may show differing levels of commitment to compliance.
subjectOf.abstract: In a federated model, enforcing regulations and policies related to AI can be complex. In a decentralized setting, different entities may have varying interpretations of regulations or differing levels of commitment to compliance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807
scope_conditions: in decentralized settings with multiple independent compliance actors

subjectOf.text: Claims that centralized AI ensures KYC and AML compliance are circular, because they rely on AI to interpret the very regulations that AI may itself violate.
subjectOf.abstract: the assertion that centralized AI ensures compliance with KYC and AML standards overlooks the circularity of relying on AI to interpret regulations it may itself violate.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How can we Best Monitor AI Agents (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5245185
scope_conditions: AI driven compliance interpretation for KYC and AML
